graph.name: Record relationship patterns · Pre
graph.description:
Record model-appraised relationship patterns from settled events for later guidance.

Lesson: Relationship changes follow evidence: retain setbacks, distinguish one reliable act from recurrence, and avoid automatic trust math.

Limitations: No automatic numerical trust delta exists. Updates are model proposals tied to evidence; actor memories and receipts have bounded capacity.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Pattern to Experience for a single kept promise; compare observation with recurrence claim.
Add a settled setback; inspect retention of both disappointment and reliability.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Relationship evidence: Sol kept a promise after previously disappointing Mira. One reliable act is now settled.

Proposed direction: A small opening in trust is plausible. Keep the earlier disappointment in history rather than replacing it with instant devotion.

Record the pattern: Analysis ≤1, unbound; numeric maps retained. State Value cannot infer trust deltas.

Express the arc: Separate Pre Character Analysis ≤1; Behavior deterministic.

History/effects: Full Post Run writes locally without review; save may be unconfirmed. Bounded history; no seed. Custom curves need explicit phase/value/elapsed, absent starts Baseline.

The next interaction with Sol (pre-scene)
Purpose: Read current Sol interaction.
Inspect: Check current observable interaction.

Mira’s current relationship state (pre-state)
Purpose: Read Mira’s relationship state.
Inspect: Check relationships/unchanged traits.

Both sides of the arc (pre-episodes)
Purpose: Read retained arc episodes.
Inspect: Check episode IDs/refs/omissions.

Guarded trust in this moment (pre-reflect)
Purpose: Appraise a modest next opening.
Inspect: Check conflicts/recalls/practical options.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Render the small opening (pre-express)
Purpose: Render behaviorHints unchanged.
Inspect: Check hint rendering; no model call. The same root Context and State snapshots, plus Episodes, feed Reflect and Express so scope, store version, source revisions and recalled evidence can be checked before rendering.

Slow-burn relationship brief (pre-output)
Purpose: Expose the relationship brief.
Inspect: Check cautious opening without forced devotion.

pre-reflect.title: Reflect · character
pre-reflect.instructions:
Appraise Mira with scene/state/episodes. Keep setbacks and reliability. Put small reversible options in behaviorHints; label interpretations. No trust math, forced romance or player decisions.

Return one raw JSON object, beginning with { and ending with }. No Markdown, fences or preface. Use at most two items in each reflection array and one concise sentence for brief.

pre-express.title: Express · behavior
pre-express.instructions: Cautious relationship options from the assessment.
